cues.en: Hello again. I have a good news.
cues.zh: 大家好，有個好消息。

cues.en: Probably it will be different by the time you see this video, but today actually Microsoft released Foundry Local to be able to run local models right on your machine itself.
cues.zh: 你看到影片時，情況可能已經不同，不過今天微軟發布了 Foundry Local，能直接在自己的電腦上執行本機模型。

cues.en: Something that will compete with Olama and Docker models as well.
cues.zh: 這會和 Ollama、Docker Models 等方案競爭。

cues.en: I wanted to show you how to actually use that also with Microsoft Asian Framework.
cues.zh: 我想展示如何搭配 Microsoft Agent Framework 使用。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and get started.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: Let's go back again to Visual Studio Code.
cues.zh: 回到 Visual Studio Code，

cues.en: I already created the project for the Foundry Local demo like we did in the first four or five different projects.
cues.zh: 已經像前面幾個專案一樣，建立好 Foundry Local Demo，

cues.en: I'm not going to go through that again.
cues.zh: 這裡就不再重複，

cues.en: I'm going to open up the project file and at this point, if we go in here and bring in three different NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 打開專案檔，加入三個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: Let me clean up these empty lines.
cues.zh: 先清除這些空白行，

cues.en: The first one is the regular Microsoft Asian Framework 1.1 at this point.
cues.zh: 第一個是目前 1.1 版的一般 Microsoft Agent Framework，

cues.en: I'm also having the new Microsoft AI Foundry Local 1.0.0.
cues.zh: 另外有新發布的 Microsoft.AI.Foundry.Local 1.0.0，

cues.en: It just happened, it was just released a few hours ago.
cues.zh: 就在幾小時前才剛推出，

cues.en: By the time you get this video, probably there will be other versions, so always try to use the latest version.
cues.zh: 你看到時可能有更新版本，所以可以優先嘗試最新版本。

cues.en: I'm also bringing another NuGet packages in here for Microsoft Extensions Logging Console.
cues.zh: 也加入 Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console，

cues.en: I'm going to show you in the code why I need this.
cues.zh: 等等會在程式碼裡解釋原因。

cues.en: Actually, it is important to bring in if you need the logging and you will see one of the APIs requires it as a matter of fact.
cues.zh: 如果需要記錄功能，這個套件很重要，而且其中一個 API 確實要求提供記錄器。

cues.en: I'm going to save all of this so I can actually import the NuGet packages.
cues.zh: 先儲存，讓 NuGet 套件下載，

cues.en: Let's go to the program, delete all of that stuff, and I'm going to go ahead and bring in some code to show you and explain it here in a second.
cues.zh: 再到 Program，刪除原本內容，貼上程式碼，稍後說明。

cues.en: We'll go back in here, we'll do a Control V and let me explain that code.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，Ctrl+V，來解釋這段程式。

cues.en: The first thing is I'm going to create an alias for one of the models that I can download on my machine.
cues.zh: 首先，建立想下載到本機的模型別名。

cues.en: I already have the CLI installed, but the CLI is still in preview.
cues.zh: 我已經安裝 CLI，不過 CLI 目前仍在預覽，

cues.en: It says 0.8.119 or something, but the Foundry itself, not the CLI,
cues.zh: 版本好像是 0.8.119；但 Foundry 本身，不是 CLI，

cues.en: the Foundry itself have been released today as a 1.0 and ready to go.
cues.zh: 今天已經發布 1.0，可以正式使用。

cues.en: I'm interested in, let's say, in 5.4 mini, for instance.
cues.zh: 這裡例如使用 Phi-4 mini。

cues.en: Instead of using the Foundry CLI, I'm going to do everything from the code in here.
cues.zh: 不透過 Foundry CLI，而是全部用這裡的程式碼操作，

cues.en: I'm going to write a line out to show you that I'm starting the AI model, and if it's already not been downloaded yet, which is about four or five gigabyte, it will need to download it,
cues.zh: 先輸出一行，告訴使用者正在啟動 AI 模型。如果尚未下載，模型大約四、五 GB，需要先下載，

cues.en: so that might take a little bit of time.
cues.zh: 所以可能花一點時間。

cues.en: Caching this might take a while, like I said, in the right line.
cues.zh: 就像輸出訊息說的，第一次快取模型可能需要等候。

cues.en: But now in the new version for Foundry Local, you will need to create a config like this, and give the app a name for the configuration.
cues.zh: 新版 Foundry Local 需要先建立這樣的 Config，並提供應用程式名稱，

cues.en: That configuration, of course, is coming from Local, from the Microsoft AI Foundry Local.
cues.zh: 這個組態型別來自 Microsoft.AI.Foundry.Local。

cues.en: You'll notice sometimes I need to create one of the web services to start it.
cues.zh: 有時還需要建立並啟動一個 Web 服務，

cues.en: That is depending really if you're going to be starting the service yourself on your machine, or if you'd like to use the chat client automatically to do the create a sync on the chat itself.
cues.zh: 取決於你要自己啟動本機服務，還是直接透過 ChatClient 的非同步建立方式處理。

cues.en: But most likely, you're going to actually create a URL in here.
cues.zh: 不過多數情況，會在這裡指定 URL，

cues.en: Let's say, for instance, the localhost 127.0.0.1, and the application will be adding the port number on the fly when it runs the service itself.
cues.zh: 例如 localhost，也就是 127.0.0.1，服務執行時再動態指派連接埠，

cues.en: That's why we have the colon zero at the end in here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡的結尾是冒號加零。

cues.en: But the app name for the configuration, you can give it whatever name.
cues.zh: Config 的 AppName 可以自行決定，

cues.en: I'm going to call it Foundry Local Demo, for instance.
cues.zh: 例如 Foundry Local Demo。

cues.en: I want to actually show you my couple of lines of code to deal with the logger.
cues.zh: 再展示兩行處理 Logger 的程式碼，

cues.en: But before I actually explain these two lines, I just want to show you the important line number 22 in here.
cues.zh: 不過解釋之前，先看重要的第 22 行，

cues.en: I need to actually now in the release version to do a Foundry Local Manager.createAsync, passing that config that contains the app name and the web for the URL.
cues.zh: 正式版現在需要呼叫 FoundryLocalManager.CreateAsync，傳入含 AppName 與 Web URL 的組態，

cues.en: It's mandatory to pass a logger.
cues.zh: 而且必須傳入 Logger，

cues.en: For some reason, they decided to do it this way.
cues.zh: 團隊選擇採用這個設計，

cues.en: You cannot pass null here.
cues.zh: 這裡不能傳 null，

cues.en: If you pass null in here, you'll get an exception.
cues.zh: 否則就會拋出例外，

cues.en: It has to be a logger.
cues.zh: 一定要有記錄器物件。

cues.en: You have two options.
cues.zh: 有兩種選擇，

cues.en: If you don't really care much, you'll notice I actually can use something called nulllogger.instance.
cues.zh: 如果不在意記錄，可以用 NullLogger.Instance，

cues.en: I comment it out.
cues.zh: 我先把它註解掉了。

cues.en: You're more than welcome to use this one, and you will not be bothered by any logs in your terminal when you run the whole thing.
cues.zh: 你也可以使用這個，執行時終端機就不會一直顯示記錄。

cues.en: I thought it would be a good idea to show you the logs that come from the system, to show you when things start and when things get unloaded and all that stuff by just adding that logger.
cues.zh: 不過我覺得展示系統記錄很有幫助，讓你看到模型何時啟動、何時卸載，所以這裡加入 Logger。

cues.en: And the way to do that is to use the using var for a variable in here, local logger factory.
cues.zh: 做法是 using var，建立 LocalLoggerFactory 變數，

cues.en: And we will go ahead and create that instance, and we'll use the build to add the console.
cues.zh: 用 LoggerFactory.Create 建立，並在 Builder 中加入 Console。

cues.en: That add console in here is the reason why I added the Microsoft extension logging.console.
cues.zh: 這個 AddConsole，就是加入 Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console 的原因，

cues.en: Without it, of course, that would not be available.
cues.zh: 否則沒有這個方法。

cues.en: So that's the only thing you need to do, is just to build the add console into the injection, the dependency injection, and we're good to go.
cues.zh: 所以只要把 Console 記錄功能加進服務設定，就準備好了。

cues.en: Now, the logger itself will use the logger factory.createLogger, passing whatever name you want.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 loggerFactory.CreateLogger，傳入任意名稱，

cues.en: I just called it the foundry local.
cues.zh: 這裡命名為 Foundry Local。

cues.en: All right, enough talking about logging.
cues.zh: 記錄功能就說到這裡。

cues.en: The only reason we have to do all of that stuff is because the second parameter to create async is mandatory and cannot take null.
cues.zh: 之所以多做這些，只因為 CreateAsync 的第二個參數必填，不能是 null。

cues.en: All righty, so now what do we do after that?
cues.zh: 接下來怎麼做呢？

cues.en: Well, we're going to create a variable like a manager, and we're going to go ahead and get the instance of the foundry local manager.
cues.zh: 先建立 Manager 變數，取得 FoundryLocalManager 的執行個體，

cues.en: All right, and then we're going to get the catalog, the model catalog.
cues.zh: 再取得 Model Catalog，

cues.en: You can say get data, get catalog async, and that will get us the object for the catalog.
cues.zh: 呼叫 GetCatalogAsync，就會拿到目錄物件。

cues.en: And finally, from the model itself, I'm going to use the catalog I just received, get model async.
cues.zh: 最後用剛取得的 Catalog，呼叫 GetModelAsync，

cues.en: I'm going to be passing the 5.4 mini.
cues.zh: 傳入 Phi-4 mini。

cues.en: And if there is an exception, it cannot find it, or I misspelled it or something, it will come back not found in the catalog.
cues.zh: 如果模型不存在，或名稱拼錯，就會回報在目錄中找不到。

cues.en: All right, now, if your machine have never seen 5.4 mini, well, we have to download it.
cues.zh: 如果這部電腦從來沒有下載 Phi-4 mini，就需要下載，

cues.en: If you already downloaded and available in your cache, it will not download it again.
cues.zh: 如果已經下載並放在快取裡，就不會重複下載，

cues.en: So that's the good news.
cues.zh: 這是好消息。

cues.en: But again, you have to make sure whoever's running this, if they have never downloaded the 4 or 5 gig of 5.4 mini, that download async will take place.
cues.zh: 不過，必須確認執行者知道：如果還沒有四、五 GB 的 Phi-4 mini，DownloadAsync 就會進行下載。

cues.en: After downloading it, now we need to load it into memory.
cues.zh: 下載完成後，還得把模型載入記憶體，

cues.en: So the model.loadAsync, that will take care of that.
cues.zh: 這由 model.LoadAsync 處理。

cues.en: And finally, that web service, the 127.0.0.1, I need to start the web service async on my machine as well. All righty?
cues.zh: 最後，127.0.0.1 的這個本機服務，也需要呼叫 StartWebServiceAsync 啟動。

cues.en: Everything else pretty much is the same, like you have seen before.
cues.zh: 其餘部分和之前看過的大致相同，

cues.en: I'm going to use an OpenAI client, which is compatible, of course.
cues.zh: 使用 OpenAIClient，因為服務相容這個介面，

cues.en: And I'm going to be passing, it's mandatory to pass the API key credentials, but this is running on local.
cues.zh: 建立時必須傳入 ApiKeyCredential，但因為在本機執行，

cues.en: There is no API.
cues.zh: 沒有真正的 API 金鑰，

cues.en: So you can put here whatever you want.
cues.zh: 所以這裡可以填任意內容，

cues.en: You can put foo if you want to, but the API credentials have to be passed anyway.
cues.zh: 例如 foo 也可以，但認證參數仍然必須提供，

cues.en: I just called my API, no API key needed, or something like that.
cues.zh: 我這裡填 No API Key Needed 之類的文字。

cues.en: And then the most important thing is I don't want to go against the OpenAI client.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，我不想連到 OpenAI 服務，

cues.en: I don't want to go and add my key for OpenAI.
cues.zh: 也不會放入真正的 OpenAI 金鑰，

cues.en: I want to change the endpoint to go local on my machine, which would be this 127.0.0.1, plus whatever port is going to be assigned to me at runtime.
cues.zh: 而是把 Endpoint 改成本機 127.0.0.1，加上執行時指派的連接埠。

cues.en: And I used to have a little bit of a problem.
cues.zh: 這裡我之前遇到一點問題，

cues.en: This did not work for me by bringing the first URL, which is the one I passed.
cues.zh: 直接使用最初的 URL，也就是剛才傳入的位址，會無法運作，

cues.en: So now in the release version, you have to concatenate the URL with the slash version one, right?
cues.zh: 正式版現在需要把 URL 後面接上 /v1，

cues.en: Without this, it will not work.
cues.zh: 沒有它就不能使用。

cues.en: I'm not sure if this is going to be different in the future and they will add it to the URL itself or not, but right now it requires the version one to be appended to the URL.
cues.zh: 不確定未來會不會改成自動把它加進 URL，但目前需要自己附加 /v1。

cues.en: From that point on, we can go ahead and create an instance for the agent.
cues.zh: 接著就能建立代理程式的執行個體，

cues.en: We'll pass in the model ID, not the model name.
cues.zh: 傳入的是 Model ID，不是模型別名，

cues.en: You have to get the model object.
cues.zh: 必須從 Model 物件取得，

cues.en: It's already 5.4.mini, but I need the ID of it.
cues.zh: 雖然前面指定 Phi-4 mini，但這裡需要它實際的 ID。

cues.en: The reason for that is depending on the machine that you have, whether using GPUs, NPUs, or CPUs, which would be very slow, we want which one really you're going to get,
cues.zh: 原因是不同電腦可能使用 GPU、NPU，或速度比較慢的 CPU，所以要確認實際取得哪個模型版本，

cues.en: because I only told it 5.4.mini.
cues.zh: 因為我只告訴它 Phi-4 mini，

cues.en: See, I didn't tell it to use CPU or GPU or NPU or whatever.
cues.zh: 沒有指定 CPU、GPU、NPU 或其他硬體。

cues.en: So now when the system will look at my hardware and find out, okay, this machine I'm running on has a pretty strong GPU coming in from the Nvidia card, for instance.
cues.zh: 系統會檢查硬體，例如發現這台電腦有性能不錯的 NVIDIA GPU，

cues.en: So I'm going to go ahead and download automatically, even though they didn't tell me to, the 5.4.mini.
cues.zh: 即使我沒有特別指定，也會自動下載 Phi-4 mini 的，

cues.en: I will go ahead and get the GPU one, for instance, that probably will behave and perform pretty well.
cues.zh: GPU 版本，這樣通常有比較好的表現和效能。

cues.en: So when I ask for the model ID, that will be the real name.
cues.zh: 所以取得 Model ID，才會得到真正的模型名稱，

cues.en: It will be a very long name.
cues.zh: 名稱可能很長，

cues.en: It has the GPU name in it and everything else. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 包含 GPU 版本等資訊，明白嗎？

cues.en: And from that point, I will return it as AI agent.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 AsAIAgent，取得代理程式。

cues.en: Nothing else changes in the code you have seen before.
cues.zh: 其餘程式碼都和之前相同，

cues.en: So I can ask my question and run it as an async or as a streaming async, get all the usage for the input and output and cached and reasoning and everything else.
cues.zh: 可以使用非同步或串流方式提問，再讀取輸入、輸出、快取、推理等用量。

cues.en: But the only difference that you're probably not used to, because this is running on your machine and we're using here C Sharp, it is not going to be garbage collected automatically.
cues.zh: 但有個可能不熟悉的差異：這是在本機執行，涉及原生資源，不會單靠 C# 垃圾回收就全部清理，

cues.en: You need to go ahead and stop the service, unload the model and dispose of the manager that you got earlier.
cues.zh: 需要停止服務、卸載模型，並 Dispose 先前取得的 Manager。

cues.en: If you don't do any of these things, you're going to get errors.
cues.zh: 如果沒做，可能會遇到錯誤，

cues.en: It will run the code.
cues.zh: 程式還是會執行，

cues.en: It will actually ask the question.
cues.zh: 也會提出問題，

cues.en: It will give you the response, but it will have exceptions at the end because you are not supposed to leave it unclean at the end, having all of these things running with the stop of the web services
cues.zh: 並得到回應，但最後可能出現例外，因為不應在程式結束後，把這些資源留著，像是沒有停止 Web 服務，

cues.en: and the model itself have not been unloaded from memory and the management has not been disposed.
cues.zh: 沒有從記憶體卸載模型，也沒有釋放管理器。

cues.en: As a matter of fact, the only one that is really going to give you an error is the last one, if you don't dispose of the manager itself in the code in here. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 實際上，最直接造成錯誤的是最後這個：如果程式裡沒有 Dispose 管理器。明白嗎？

cues.en: So these are all the things that you need to do.
cues.zh: 這些就是需要做的處理，

cues.en: This is a simple one.
cues.zh: 這裡只是簡單範例，

cues.en: Maybe in the future, we'll make another video to show you how to add your own tools, for instance, and actually make it a bit more complicated.
cues.zh: 未來也許會再錄一段，展示如何加入自訂工具，讓功能更豐富。

cues.en: But for right now, out of the box, being able to use the Foundry Local Manager on your machine, download it, getting the model catalog,
cues.zh: 不過目前已經能直接在自己的電腦使用 FoundryLocalManager，下載模型、取得模型目錄，

cues.en: getting the model, loading the model, and then start asking questions against the agent, everything will work just fine at this point.
cues.zh: 取得模型、載入，再透過代理程式提問，現在應該都能順利運作。

cues.en: All right, let's go ahead and save this file and see if we can get it to work.
cues.zh: 儲存檔案，看看是否真的能成功，

cues.en: We'll say .NET run.
cues.zh: 執行 dotnet run，

cues.en: And again, this is running the latest and greatest that was just released today.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這使用的是今天才剛發布的最新版本，

cues.en: We got a small error in here.
cues.zh: 這裡有個小錯誤，

cues.en: Let's see what the error is.
cues.zh: 看看是什麼，

cues.en: From the error itself, it looks like it can't read the target, even though my target is .NET 10 right here.
cues.zh: 從錯誤看起來，似乎無法讀取目標框架，但這裡明明指定 .NET 10，

cues.en: Let's go ahead and do a restore.
cues.zh: 先執行 Restore，

cues.en: We'll say .NET restore for all the packages, for the NuGet packages to make sure everything is good.
cues.zh: 也就是 dotnet restore，還原所有 NuGet 套件，確認相依性正確，

cues.en: All right, that succeeded.
cues.zh: 這一步成功了，

cues.en: We'll say .NET build.
cues.zh: 再執行 dotnet build，

cues.en: We'll do it manually and see if we still get the error.
cues.zh: 手動建置，看看錯誤還在不在，

cues.en: Yes, we still get the error, so something else is wrong.
cues.zh: 還是出錯，所以還有其他問題。

cues.en: Yes, I went and got a little bit more information about the release version, and it looks because this runs actually on Linux, on Macs, and Windows, and Win64 as well,
cues.zh: 我查了一些正式版資訊，因為這能在 Linux、Mac、Windows，以及 Windows 64 位元執行，

cues.en: it looks like the restoring and the build have actually not been able to realize that a .NET that needs to happen for Win64.
cues.zh: 看起來還原與建置沒有正確判斷，這裡需要 Windows 64 位元的執行階段資產。

cues.en: To fix that problem, folks, we're going to go into the project itself, maybe after Nullable, and you can bring in this runtime identifier, and I'm telling it that I'm building actually for Win64, okay?
cues.zh: 修正方式是到專案檔，例如 Nullable 後面，加入 RuntimeIdentifier，明確指定這次建置 win-x64，

cues.en: And that will allow it, hopefully, to work.
cues.zh: 希望這樣就能運作。

cues.en: So we'll do this, and we'll go back up for .NET build, and let's see if that will build it correctly at this point, and it looks like that was the issue.
cues.zh: 設定後，再執行 dotnet build，看看能否正確建置。看來問題就在這裡，

cues.en: The Foundry local was not able to figure out that we're running under Win64, so we have to identify the runtime in here.
cues.zh: Foundry Local 沒有自動判斷我們使用 Windows 64 位元，所以需要明確標示執行階段。

cues.en: All right, let's go ahead and do a .NET run now, and let's see if we can actually make this work.
cues.zh: 現在執行 dotnet run，看看這次是否成功，

cues.en: And I'm going to bring up the code again so you can see what's happening in here.
cues.zh: 也把程式碼打開，方便看到流程，

cues.en: You are more than welcome to run the debugger from all the way at the top by saying debug the project, so you can go line by line and understand what is happening.
cues.zh: 你可以從上方選 Debug Project，啟動偵錯器，逐行檢查實際發生什麼，

cues.en: But notice also my logger is putting things out.
cues.zh: 另外也注意，Logger 正在輸出記錄，

cues.en: You see Foundry local, that's the name I gave it, initialized successfully.
